input.title: Men's Hunting – Today's Special: Tag Soup Embroidered Zip Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

TODAY'S SPECIAL: TAG SOUP. This hunting zip up hoodie is for the hunter whose season ended with an unfilled tag, worn to deer camp, the tailgate and the cold walk back to the truck.

On the back, a deer in a tall chef's hat ladles a green ladle through a big striped bowl of soup with an orange hunting tag floating in it and steam curling up, under TODAY'S SPECIAL: in orange capitals above and TAG SOUP in heavy capitals below, with SERVED FRESH EVERY SEASON as the small line underneath. The lettering is cream on Navy and Black and deep navy on Ash. On the front, a steaming soup bowl with a hunting tag in it is embroidered on the left chest and the word SOUP is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Navy and Black and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest soup bowl and tag, left-cuff SOUP, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Navy, Black, Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

What does tag soup mean on this hunting zip hoodie?
Tag soup is hunter slang for a season that ends with the tag still unfilled. The Today's Special: Tag Soup zip hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. turns that bad luck into a menu item: a deer chef ladling soup with an orange tag floating in it, for the hunter who laughs at his own season.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full deer chef, bowl and TAG SOUP lettering are printed across the back of this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, so the zipper never splits the art. On the front, a small embroidered soup bowl with a tag sits on the left chest and SOUP is stitched on the left cuff.

How does the Tag Soup zip hoodie fit?
It is a regular unisex fit with a full metal zipper in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size, or go up one to layer it over a flannel or a thermal. Graphic Tees Co. offers one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery, so a wrong guess costs nothing.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and fabric softener, and do not iron over the stitching. The bowl on the chest and the SOUP cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash.

Will the Tag Soup zip hoodie arrive in time for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 to have your Tag Soup zip hoodie before Christmas. Graphic Tees Co. makes each one to order, and orders over $45 ship free in the US, which this hoodie clears. It is a good gift for the hunter in the family who did not fill his tag this year.
